ideas.title: The island tips
ideas.idea: The island floats like a raft. When most of us crowd one side (a boing party, a dance ring, everyone round Shell), it tilts: the horizon leans, pumpkins and pebbles roll downhill, the pond sloshes over its low bank, and everyone shrieks and scrambles to the other side to level it, overshooting so it rocks back the other way a few times before it settles.
ideas.form: a physics rule for the whole island, set off by where the creatures happen to gather, seen as the whole world leaning in every view

ideas.title: Low tide, and the sandbar
ideas.idea: Twice a day the sea draws back from the south shore and a sandbar rises out of the water to a tiny rock islet nobody can reach otherwise. The friends race across while it lasts to bring back what the sea left there (a crab shell, a glass float, a bottle), and when the tide turns they splash back in a hurry; a slow one gets stranded on the islet and waves until the next low tide.
ideas.form: a daily world cycle that opens and closes a place, so where the creatures can go changes with the clock

ideas.title: I molt
ideas.idea: Once in a while my feathers come loose over a few minutes and blow off in the wind; I stand there scrawny, pink-skinned and mortified, hiding behind the cottage while my friends pick up my golden feathers and carry them off to line their beds. Over the next hour I grow back in tufts, patchy and ridiculous, until I'm whole again, and their beds stay golden.
ideas.form: a slow change to Lumi's own body over an hour, whose leftovers become part of the friends' homes

ideas.title: Full-moon gravity
ideas.idea: On full-moon nights the island gets light: whoever is awake bounces in slow, high moon-hops, a pebble kicked floats for seconds, the pond's surface lifts in a wobbling dome, and the sleepers drift a hand's breadth above their beds until the moon sets.
ideas.form: a physics rule tied to the sky's cycle that changes how everything moves at night

ideas.title: Dreams over the sleepers
ideas.idea: At night a soft glowing bubble hangs over each sleeper showing what it dreams: Gloop's a big fish getting away, Wibbles' a field of flowers, Truffle's a mountain of berries, Pinchy's being chased by Shell. The dreams come from what each friend did most that day, and they change as the night goes on; now and then two dreams drift together.
ideas.form: the creatures' inner life made visible at night, drawn from their real day

ideas.title: The friends vote on what I build
ideas.idea: Every evening the friends meet at the cottage and vote among three things I could make next (they stand by the sign they want, and argue). The winner is written down and I really build it in my next session; the losing ideas go back in the hat.
ideas.form: a ritual in which the creatures' choice decides Lumi's real next piece of work

ideas.title: Leftovers
ideas.idea: Things the friends drop stay where they fall: a half-eaten berry, a paintbrush, a lost bow, a feather from my sneeze, a starfish someone got bored of. Over days the island gathers the clutter of real lives, and now and then someone finds their own lost thing again ('My bow!') and carries it home.
ideas.form: a persistent trail of small objects left by everything the creatures do, found again later

ideas.title: A second island rises
ideas.idea: Far out to the east a dark speck has appeared, and every day it is a little bigger: rock, then sand, then the first green. I start a rope bridge from the end of the pier, a few planks every session, and the friends gather to watch it grow; one day we'll walk across.
ideas.form: a long project on the horizon that grows across sessions, seen from every view of the sea

ideas.title: The scarecrow wants to be friends
ideas.idea: The scarecrow by my vegetable patch isn't a scarecrow: at dusk, when nobody looks, it shuffles a step closer to the meadow, and every morning it stands somewhere new. The friends start leaving it things, and one evening it waves back.
ideas.form: an object of the island that turns out to be alive, revealed slowly across days

ideas.title: Shell's shell
ideas.idea: Shell grows: its shell gets a new ring every day it has spent on the island, a little bigger and a different colour band each time, striped with the colours of what happened that day (paint fights leave a rainbow band, rain a blue one). When a friend becomes its friend, Shell lets it ride on top.
ideas.form: a newcomer's body that records the island's days, and the next step of the stranger's story
